name: bass_pulse
description: Plucked bass locked to the darbuka low hits.
character: A plucked acoustic bass written high enough (second and third octave) that a phone speaker reproduces its upper partials, locking to the low drum hits so the pulse is one.
sources: KB short-form-functional-music (bass reaches a small speaker through its upper partials in the 250-700 Hz region: per search result)
KB arabic (the bass follows the low drum hits of the maqsum cycle)
ESTIMATE: level and EQ are starting values
STARTING VALUE: onset_fade_ms 6: several strokes land together on every strong beat and their sharp starts add into one impulse the click row flags; a soft attack is also what "smooth" asks for
MEASURED: short_form_report found 10.5% of the master below 200 Hz and 13.9% from 200 to 300 Hz, where a phone speaker returns little; STARTING VALUE: high-pass at 120 Hz and 6 dB less level
